package planning
import (
 "bytes"
 "context"
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "reflect"
 "testing"
 "github.com/Yui-Qi-Tang/calx/finite"
 "github.com/Yui-Qi-Tang/calx/sat"
 "github.com/Yui-Qi-Tang/calx/sat/cadical"
 "github.com/Yui-Qi-Tang/pouch/internal/validation"
)
type calxAdapter struct{runner *cadical.Runner}
func (a calxAdapter) Solve(ctx context.Context,id string,c CNF)(SolveResult,error){
 in:=sat.CNF{Clauses:c.Clauses};for _,v:=range c.Variables{raw,_:=json.Marshal(v);in.Variables=append(in.Variables,sat.Variable{ID:v.ID,Metadata:map[string]string{"pouch_variable":string(raw)}})}
 r,err:=a.runner.Solve(ctx,id,in);out:=SolveResult{Status:string(r.Status),Assignment:r.Assignment}
 for _,v:=range r.Artifacts{out.Artifacts=append(out.Artifacts,Artifact{ID:v.ID,SHA256:v.SHA256,Bytes:v.Bytes})}
 if err!=nil{return out,err};err=r.Require(sat.Requirements{SATModelChecked:true,UNSATProofChecked:true});out.Verified=err==nil;return out,err
}
func TestCalxExactEncoding(t *testing.T){
 c:=twoBits();raw,_:=json.Marshal(c.Model);var model finite.Model;if err:=json.Unmarshal(raw,&model);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 m,err:=Project(c);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 fm,err:=finite.Project(model);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if !reflect.DeepEqual(m.Guard,fm.Guard)||!reflect.DeepEqual(m.Effect,fm.Effect)||!reflect.DeepEqual(m.Frame,fm.Frame){t.Fatal("matrix mismatch")}
 opts,_:=(Options{}).defaults()
 for h:=0;h<=3;h++{
  original,err:=encode(context.Background(),m,c.Model.Forbidden,c.Start,c.Goal,h,nil,opts);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  q:=finite.Query{Profile:finite.Profile,Start:finite.State(c.Start),Goal:finite.State(c.Goal),Horizon:h}
  replacement,err:=finite.Compile(context.Background(),model,q,finite.Options{});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  var a,b bytes.Buffer;original.CNF.WriteDIMACS(&a);replacement.CNF().WriteDIMACS(&b)
  if !bytes.Equal(a.Bytes(),b.Bytes()){t.Fatalf("CNF differs at horizon %d",h)}
  values,ok:=solveTruth(original.CNF.Clauses,map[int]bool{},len(original.CNF.Variables));if !ok{continue}
  oldTrace,err:=original.trace(values);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};newTrace,err:=replacement.Decode(values);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  oldJSON,_:=json.Marshal(oldTrace.States);newJSON,_:=json.Marshal(newTrace.States)
  if !bytes.Equal(oldJSON,newJSON)||!reflect.DeepEqual(oldTrace.Actions,newTrace.Actions){t.Fatal("trace mismatch")}
 }
}
func TestCalxNativeSearchAndIndependentReplay(t *testing.T){
 r,err:=cadical.New(cadical.Config{SolverPath:os.Getenv("CALX_CADICAL"),SolverSHA256:os.Getenv("CALX_CADICAL_SHA256"),CheckerPath:os.Getenv("CALX_DRAT"),CheckerSHA256:os.Getenv("CALX_DRAT_SHA256"),ArtifactDir:filepath.Join(os.Getenv("CALX_CONSUMER_OUTPUT"),"pouch-solver")});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 c:=twoBits();got,err:=Search(context.Background(),c,calxAdapter{r},Options{});if err!=nil||!got.Complete||len(got.Forward)!=2{t.Fatal(got,err)}
 raw,_:=json.Marshal(c);authority,err:=validation.NewAuthority(raw,validation.Digest(raw));if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 for _,p:=range got.Forward{if _,err:=authority.ReplayForward(context.Background(),p.Trace);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}}
 for _,ret:=range got.Returns{if ret.Status!="RETURN_FOUND"||ret.Trace==nil||len(ret.Trace.Actions)!=2{t.Fatal(ret)}
  reverse:=c;reverse.Start=ret.Endpoint;reverse.Goal=c.Baseline;reverse.ForwardLimit=c.ReturnLimit;raw,_=json.Marshal(reverse);a,err:=validation.NewAuthority(raw,validation.Digest(raw));if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};if _,err=a.ReplayForward(context.Background(),*ret.Trace);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 }
}
